Risk appetite: carry trades fund in yen

regime.why: Oil vs yields: + = oil is an inflation story; - = oil is a growth tax (2008-style)
Stocks vs yields: - = rates drive stocks; + = growth scare, bonds hedge stocks
Credit vs tech: high + = credit and equities are one trade (credit stress leading)
Dollar vs stocks: - = safe-haven dollar; ~0/+ = "sell America" or liquidity dash
Aussie vs tech: near 0 = AUD trading commodities not risk
Gold vs real yields: near 0/+ = gold trading liquidity or debasement, not rates
Bitcoin vs tech: high = one liquidity complex
Energy stocks vs oil: falling = equity investors fade the oil move
Yen vs yields: high = yen is a pure rates trade
France vs Italy spreads: high = euro-periphery contagion, low = France-specific
